replay_assumptions: Watchtower completion is checked through quest.watchtower.complete.
Gnome Stronghold balloon-route unlock is an existing shared flag; this route requires it in addition to Enlightened Journey.

The previous Monkey Madness I amulet and RFD ninja greegree are owned from upstream. Optional purchases cover fruit/mortar/logs and Tutab's monkey talisman; trade-disabled profiles can seed owned supplies.
The randomized Kruk agility and tank branches are modeled separately; the primary replay uses agility, with alternate tank path available for players equipped for obstacles.
Airship explosives are six consumed charged satchels, one per distinct placement. Being caught may require a barrel refill, but previously placed charges persist.
The onyx device requires both hammer and chisel. Nieve's four Stronghold gorillas are distinct from the four in the crash cavern and from three laboratory gorillas.
Glough is modeled as three planned outcomes. Death and exit reset the encounter sequence, which is not yet fully modeled for retry paths.
Duke's reward is claimed at an NPC only after Daero training. The two combat choices are immediate; modeled as a single two-pick reward with nonretainable state.
